description: Join a dedicated team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL, as a Full-time Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA). This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to patient recovery and well-being, working alongside experienced therapists to implement individualized treatment plans. We are seeking a passionate professional ready to make a significant impact in a supportive environment.In this full-time role, you will play a crucial part in helping patients regain independence and improve their quality of life. You will assist in providing comprehensive occupational therapy services, ensuring high-quality care and positive outcomes for our residents. We value teamwork and a commitment to excellence in patient care.This position offers competitive compensation and the chance to grow your career within a dynamic healthcare setting. If you are a skilled COTA looking for a rewarding full-time opportunity, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) licensure/certification.
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility preferred.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation for COTA/PTA is $28.00 - $37.00 per hour.
